Blackbelly, three written proposals

Blackbelly Market quoted all three meals on Nov 6, each at 150 people with staff included. Every figure below is the proposal's grand total: food, beverage, labor, a 20% admin fee and 9.195% sales tax. No gratuity is charged. Nothing is signed; each needs a 50% deposit to hold.

ProposalFoodBeverageLaborAll-inA head
Wednesday at Pearl WestBreakfast buffet, slider lunch, cookies, almonds and crudités all day, coffee and tea. Captain plus two servers, 8.5 hours.$8,250$600$893$12,571$84
Thursday dayGrab-and-go burritos, pastries and fruit at 8 before the coaches; slider lunch 12:30 to 2; almonds, crudités and cookies 1:30 to 5; coffee to go, then coffee, lemonade, iced tea and sodas. Captain plus two servers, 10 hours.$6,350$1,500$1,050$11,433$76
Thursday dinner at Dan'sCheese and charcuterie, almonds and olives out; passed bites, skewers for half the room, fried chicken and mini burger sliders, dessert bites; premium non-alcoholic bar package, coffee and tea. Captain, two servers, two bartenders, lead chef and two cooks, 5.5 hours.$7,975$1,950$1,540$14,687$98
Three proposals$22,575$4,050$3,483$38,692$258
What changed
The two conference days were carried at $208 a head as an estimate ($26 breakfast, $46 lunch, $32 breaks each day). Blackbelly feeds the same agenda for $160, so the daytime line drops about $7,200. Thursday dinner was carried at $100 a head against the Pizzeria Alberico benchmark; Blackbelly's $98 lands on it almost exactly, so that line barely moves.
Alcohol
None of the three Blackbelly proposals includes wine or beer. Corrida's $378 is all-in including its bar; Dan's dinner is not. The bar at Dan's now carries $4,200: bought retail from a Boulder wine shop and poured by Blackbelly's bartenders, planned at about four drinks a head for a mostly male room of 150. That is 12 cases of Colorado craft beer, 72 bottles of wine (two-thirds red), 10 bottles of Colorado whiskey, tax, 450 rented glasses, ice, and $500 held for any Blackbelly bar or corkage fee. Unopened bottles go back to the shop.
A discrepancy to raise
On the Thursday day proposal the beverage items add to $1,950 but the billing page carries $1,500. The $11,433 total is built on $1,500. If Blackbelly corrects it, the day rises about $590 all-in.
Dietary
Gluten free, dairy free and vegan versions are available on request across all three. Half the dinner skewers and a third of the sliders are vegetarian-ready; confirm counts against registrations in May.
Still to confirm
Whether the tent and rentals line already covers the serving tables Blackbelly will need at Dan's. Hold dates in writing for June 16 and 17.
